rules.alias_precedence: The exact published measure ID wins; a reviewed alias from measure_id_aliases fills only a hospital and window the exact ID leaves empty; the row keeps published_measure_id.
rules.changed_models: A changed model equals its baseline on every column not named in its changes; its new and retyped columns are checked by the package's tests and expected-failure cases.
rules.fills: A filled column keeps its published value in <column>_published and names its source in <column>_source.
rules.hold_key: md5(concat_ws('|', bronze_table, hold_reason, coalesce(entity_id or ccn, '<null>'), coalesce(measure_id, '<null>'), coalesce(cast(window_start or fiscal_year as varchar), '<null>'), coalesce(cast(window_end as varchar), '<null>'))); unique test per hold model
rules.unchanged_models: A model marked unchanged must equal its baseline_rows and baseline_content on the fixture.
rules.value_preservation: A typed column keeps its published text beside it unless a cast test proves every non-blank published value cast exactly (silver plan section 5). The check of silver section 5 fails a typed column with neither.
rules.column_order: Column order is not binding: checks compare column names and types. The adjacency edge checks keep their original ordered form. int_hac_program_years and int_vbp_program_years list their columns in the built order.
